Bank-Math-Master.question: ১) A worker completes 1/6 of a job in 8 days. At the same rate, how many more days will he need to finish the remaining work?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A worker completes 1/6 of a job in 8 days. At the same rate, how many more days will he need to finish the remaining work?

Solution:
Work done = 1/6
remaining work = 1 - (1/6) = 5/6

He completes 1/6 of a job in 8 days
∴ He completes 1 whole job in (8 × 6) days = 48 days

∴ More days required = 48 - 8
= 40 days.

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২) One pipe can fill a tank four times as fast as another pipe. If the two pipes together can fill the tank in 18 minutes, how long will the slower pipe alone take to fill the tank?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: One pipe can fill a tank four times as fast as another pipe. If the two pipes together can fill the tank in 18 minutes, how long will the slower pipe alone take to fill the tank?

Solution:
ধরি,
ধীরগতির পাইপ একা ট্যাংকটি পূর্ণ করে = x মিনিটে
∴ 1 মিনিটে পূর্ণ করে = 1/x অংশ

তাহলে দ্রুত পাইপটি পূর্ণ করবে = x/4 মিনিটে
∴ 1 মিনিটে পূর্ণ করে = 4/x অংশ

প্রশ্নমতে,
(1/x) + (4/x) = 1/18

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৩) A can complete a piece of work in 24 days, B in 72 days, and C in 36 days. A works alone, but B and C assist him on every third day. In how many days will the entire work be completed?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A can complete a piece of work in 24 days, B in 72 days, and C in 36 days. A works alone, but B and C assist him on every third day. In how many days will the entire work be completed?

Solution:
A-এর 1 দিনের কাজ = 1/24 অংশ
∴ A-এর 2 দিনের কাজ = (1/24) × 2
= 1/12 অংশ
B-এর 1 দিনের কাজ = 1/72 অংশ
C-এর 1 দিনের কাজ = 1/36 অংশ

(A + B + C)-এর 1 দিনের কাজ = (1/24) + (1/72) + (1/36)
= (3 + 1 + 2)/72
= 6/72
= 1/12 অংশ

প্রতি 3 দিনে সম্পন্ন কাজ = (1/12) + (1/12)
= 1/6 অংশ

এখন,
1/6 অংশ কাজ সম্পন্ন হয় = 3 দিনে
∴ সম্পূর্ণ কাজ সম্পন্ন হবে = 3 × 6 দিনে
= 18 দিনে

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৪) Two inlet pipes can fill a water tank separately in 12 hours and 20 hours, respectively. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, how long will they take to fill the tank completely?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Two inlet pipes can fill a water tank separately in 12 hours and 20 hours, respectively. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, how long will they take to fill the tank completely?

Solution:
প্রথম পাইপের 1 ঘণ্টার কাজ = 1/12 অংশ
দ্বিতীয় পাইপের 1 ঘণ্টার কাজ = 1/20 অংশ

∴ উভয় পাইপের 1 ঘণ্টার সম্মিলিত কাজ = (1/12) + (1/20)
= (5 + 3)/60
= 8/60
= 2/15 অংশ

∴ সম্পূর্ণ ট্যাংক পূর্ণ করতে প্রয়োজনীয় সময় = 1/(2/15)
= 15/2 ঘণ্টা
= 7.5 ঘণ্টা

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৫) 18 women can complete a piece of work in 14 days, whereas 12 men can complete the same work in 7 days. What is the ratio of the work capacity of one man to one woman?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 18 women can complete a piece of work in 14 days, whereas 12 men can complete the same work in 7 days. What is the ratio of the work capacity of one man to one woman?

Solution:
18 women can complete the work in 14 days.
∴ 1 woman can complete the work in = (18 × 14) days
= 252 days

∴ One woman's 1 day's work = 1/252

Similarly,
12 men can complete the same work in 7 days.
∴ 1 man can complete the work in (12 × 7) days
= 84 days

∴ One man's 1 day's work = 1/84

∴ Ratio of the work capacity of one man to one woman
= (1/84) : (1/252)
= 252 : 84
= 3 : 1

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৬) 4 identical pumps, each working 5 hours a day, can empty a reservoir in 3 days. How many hours must 6 such pumps work to empty the same reservoir in 1 day?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 4 identical pumps, working 5 hours a day, can empty a reservoir in 3 days. How many hours a day must 6 such pumps work to empty the same reservoir in 1 day?

Solution:
4টি পাম্প 3 দিনে কাজটি সম্পন্ন করতে প্রতিদিন কাজ করে = 5 ঘণ্টা
∴ 1টি পাম্প 3 দিনে কাজটি সম্পন্ন করতে প্রতিদিন কাজ করবে = 5 × 4 ঘণ্টা
∴ 6টি পাম্প 3 দিনে কাজটি সম্পন্ন করতে প্রতিদিন কাজ করবে = (5 × 4)/6 ঘণ্টা
∴ 6টি পাম্প 1 দিনে কাজটি সম্পন্ন করতে প্রতিদিন কাজ করবে = (5 × 4 × 3)/(6 × 1) ঘণ্টা
= 60/6 ঘণ্টা
= 10 ঘণ্টা

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৭) A storage tank can be completely filled with 18 buckets of water, each having a capacity of 12 liters. How many buckets will be required to fill the same tank if each bucket has a capacity of 9 liters?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A storage tank can be completely filled with 18 buckets of water, each having a capacity of 12 liters. How many buckets will be required to fill the same tank if each bucket has a capacity of 9 liters?

Solution:
Capacity of the tank = 18 × 12 liters
= 216 liters

Number of 9 liter buckets required = 216/9
= 24

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৮) A and B together can complete a project in 18 days, while A alone can complete it in 30 days. In how many days can B alone complete the project?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A and B together can complete a project in 18 days, while A alone can complete it in 30 days. In how many days can B alone complete the project?

Solution:
A and B together complete the work in = 18 days
∴ One day's work of (A + B) = 1/18

A alone completes the work in = 30 days
∴ One day's work of A = 1/30

Therefore, B's one day's work = (1/18) - (1/30)
= (5 - 3)/90
= 2/90
= 1/45

∴ B alone can complete the work in = 45 days.

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৯) Pipe A can fill a water tank in 40 minutes. Pipe B can fill the same tank twice as fast as Pipe A. If both pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty, how long will it take to fill the tank completely?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Pipe A can fill a water tank in 40 minutes. Pipe B can fill the same tank twice as fast as Pipe A. If both pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty, how long will it take to fill the tank completely?

Solution:
Pipe A fills the tank in = 40 minutes

Since Pipe B works twice as fast as Pipe A,
Pipe B fills the tank in = 40/2 minutes
= 20 minutes

Pipe A's 1-minute work = 1/40 part
Pipe B's 1-minute work = 1/20 part

∴ Together, the two pipes fill in 1 minute = (1/40) + (1/20)
= (1 + 2)/40
= 3/40 part

The two pipes fill 3/40 part of the tank in = 1 minute
∴ Time required to fill the whole tank = 40/3 minutes
= 13 minutes 20 seconds

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১০) Mita completes 2/3 of a piece of work in 16 days. She then receives assistance from Nila, and together they complete the remaining work in 4 days. How many days would Nila alone take to complete the entire work?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Mita completes 2/3 of a piece of work in 16 days. She then receives assistance from Nila, and together they complete the remaining work in 4 days. How many days would Nila alone take to complete the entire work?

Solution:
Mita completes 2/3 of the work in = 16 days

∴ Mita's 1 day's work = (2/3)/16
= 2/48
= 1/24 part

∴ Remaining work = 1 - (2/3)
= 1/3 part

Mita and Nila together complete 1/3 of the work in = 4 days

∴ Their combined 1 day's work = (1/3)/4
= 1/12 part

Nila's 1 day's work = (1/12) - (1/24)
= (2 - 1)/24
= 1/24 part

∴ Nila alone would take 24 days to complete the entire work.

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১১) Two conveyor belts, A and B, can fill a grain storage bin independently in 24 minutes and 36 minutes, respectively. A third conveyor belt, C, can empty the full bin in 18 minutes. Initially, A and B are operated together. After 6 minutes, conveyor C is also switched on. How much additional time will be required to fill the bin completely?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Two conveyor belts, A and B, can fill a grain storage bin independently in 24 minutes and 36 minutes, respectively. A third conveyor belt, C, can empty the full bin in 18 minutes. Initially, A and B are operated together. After 6 minutes, conveyor C is also switched on. How much additional time will be required to fill the bin completely?

Solution:
Let,
the capacity of the storage bin be the LCM of 24, 36 and 18 = 72 units

Efficiency of A = 72/24
= 3 units/minute

Efficiency of B = 72/36
= 2 units/minute

Efficiency of C = - (72/18)
= - 4 units/minute

For the first 6 minutes, only A and B operate.

Combined efficiency of A and B = 3 + 2
= 5 units/minute

Work completed in 6 minutes = 6 × 5
= 30 units

∴ Remaining work = 72 - 30
= 42 units

After conveyor C is switched on,
the combined efficiency becomes = 3 + 2 - 4
= 1 unit/minute

∴ Additional time required = 42/1
= 42 minutes

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১২) 10 men can complete a construction task in 18 days, while 12 women can complete the same task in 30 days. In how many days will 6 men and 12 women together complete the task?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 10 men can complete a construction task in 18 days, while 12 women can complete the same task in 30 days. In how many days will 6 men and 12 women together complete the task?

Solution:
For the same amount of work,
10 × 18 man-days = 12 × 30 woman-days
⇒ 180 man-days = 360 woman-days
⇒ 1 man's work = 2 women's work

∴ 6 men's work = 6 × 2 women's work
= 12 women's work

Therefore,
6 men + 12 women = 12 women + 12 women
= 24 women's work

Now,
12 women can complete the work in = 30 days
∴ 1 woman can complete the work in = 30 × 12 days
∴ 24 women can complete the same work in = (12 × 30)/24 days
= 15 days

∴ 6 men and 12 women together can complete the same work in 15 days.

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৩) Pipe A can fill a cistern in 12 hours, while Pipe B can fill the same cistern in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be completely filled?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 12 hours, while Pipe B can fill the same cistern in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the cistern be completely filled?

Solution:
Pipe A's 1-hour work = 1/12 part
Pipe B's 1-hour work = 1/18 part

∴ Together, their 1-hour work = (1/12) + (1/18)
= (3 + 2)/36
= 5/36 part

∴ Time required to fill the whole cistern = 1/(5/36)
= 36/5 hours
= 7.2 hours

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৪) 12 workers can complete the construction of a boundary wall in 15 days. If 3 additional workers with the same work capacity join them, in how many days will the work be completed?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 12 workers can complete the construction of a boundary wall in 15 days. If 3 additional workers with the same work capacity join them, in how many days will the work be completed?

Solution:
12 workers can complete the work in = 15 days

Total number of workers after 3 additional workers join = 12 + 3
= 15 workers

For the same amount of work,
12 workers complete the work in = 15 days
∴ 1 worker completes the work in = (15 × 12) days
∴ 15 workers complete the work in = (15 × 12)/15 days
= 12 days

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৫) A water tank is 5/8 full. If 45 liters of water are removed, the tank becomes empty. What is the total capacity of the tank?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A water tank is 5/8 full. If 45 liters of water are removed, the tank becomes empty. What is the total capacity of the tank?

Solution:
Let the total capacity of the tank be = 8x liters.

Since the tank is 5/8 full,
Amount of water in the tank = 5x liters

According to the question,
5x = 45
⇒ x = 45/5
⇒ x = 9

Therefore, the total capacity of the tank = 8x
= 8 × 9
= 72 liters

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৬) A can complete a piece of work in 20 days and B can complete the same work in 30 days. They work together for 6 days, after which A leaves. How many more days will B need to complete the remaining work?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A can complete a piece of work in 20 days and B can complete the same work in 30 days. They work together for 6 days, after which A leaves. How many more days will B need to complete the remaining work?

Solution:
A-এর 1 দিনের কাজ = 1/20 অংশ
B-এর 1 দিনের কাজ = 1/30 অংশ

∴ A ও B-এর সম্মিলিত 1 দিনের কাজ = (1/20) + (1/30)
= (3 + 2)/60
= 5/60
= 1/12 অংশ

তারা একসঙ্গে 6 দিনে সম্পন্ন করে = 6 × (1/12)
= 1/2 অংশ

∴ অবশিষ্ট কাজ = 1 - (1/2)
= 1/2 অংশ

B একা 1 দিনে কাজ করে = 1/30 অংশ

∴ B-এর 1/2 অংশ কাজ করতে সময় লাগবে = (1/2)/(1/30)
= 15 দিন

∴ B-এর আরও 15 দিন লাগবে।

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৭) A pipe can fill a tank in 15 hours, while a leak can empty the full tank in 30 hours. If the pipe and the leak are both open, how long will it take to fill the empty tank?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: A pipe can fill a tank in 15 hours, while a leak can empty the full tank in 30 hours. If the pipe and the leak are both open, how long will it take to fill the empty tank?

Solution:
পাইপটির 1 ঘণ্টার কাজ = 1/15 অংশ
লিকটি 1 ঘণ্টায় খালি করে = 1/30 অংশ

∴ উভয়ই খোলা থাকলে 1 ঘণ্টায় ট্যাংকে নিট পানি জমবে = (1/15) - (1/30)
= (2 - 1)/30
= 1/30 অংশ

∴ সম্পূর্ণ ট্যাংক পূর্ণ হতে সময় লাগবে = 1/(1/30)
= 30 ঘণ্টা

∴ ট্যাংকটি পূর্ণ হতে 30 ঘণ্টা লাগবে।

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৮) 24 workers can complete a piece of work in 18 days. After working for 6 days, 8 workers leave the job. How many more days will the remaining workers need to complete the work?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 24 workers can complete a piece of work in 18 days. After working for 6 days, 8 workers leave the job. How many more days will the remaining workers need to complete the work?

Solution:
মোট কাজ = 24 × 18
= 432 শ্রমিক-দিন

প্রথম 6 দিনে 24 জন শ্রমিকের সম্পন্ন কাজ = 24 × 6
= 144 শ্রমিক-দিন

∴ অবশিষ্ট কাজ = 432 - 144
= 288 শ্রমিক-দিন

8 জন শ্রমিক চলে যাওয়ার পর অবশিষ্ট শ্রমিক = 24 - 8
= 16 জন

∴ 16 জন শ্রমিকের অবশিষ্ট কাজটি করতে সময় লাগবে = 288/16
= 18 দিন

∴ অবশিষ্ট শ্রমিকদের আরও 18 দিন লাগবে।

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৯) Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours, while Pipe B can fill the same tank in 18 hours. Both pipes are opened together for 4 hours, after which Pipe B is closed. How much additional time will Pipe A take to fill the remaining part of the tank?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours, while Pipe B can fill the same tank in 18 hours. Both pipes are opened together for 4 hours, after which Pipe B is closed. How much additional time will Pipe A take to fill the remaining part of the tank?

Solution:
Pipe A-এর 1 ঘণ্টার কাজ = 1/12 অংশ
Pipe B-এর 1 ঘণ্টার কাজ = 1/18 অংশ

∴ উভয় পাইপের সম্মিলিত 1 ঘণ্টার কাজ = (1/12) + (1/18)
= (3 + 2)/36
= 5/36 অংশ

∴ উভয় পাইপ 4 ঘণ্টায় পূর্ণ করে = 4 ×(5/36)
= 20/36
= 5/9 অংশ

∴ অবশিষ্ট অংশ = 1 - (5/9)
= 4/9

এখন,
Pipe B বন্ধ করে দেওয়া হলে শুধু Pipe A কাজ করবে।

Pipe A 1 ঘণ্টায় পূর্ণ করে = 1/12 অংশ

∴ Pipe A-এর 4/9 অংশ পূর্ণ করতে প্রয়োজনীয় সময় = (4/9)/(1/12)
= (4/9) × 12
= 16/3 ঘণ্টা
= 5 ঘণ্টা 20 মিনিট

∴ Pipe A-এর অতিরিক্ত 5 ঘণ্টা 20 মিনিট সময় লাগবে।

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২০) 15 workers can complete a project in 24 days. They work for 8 days, after which 5 additional workers of the same efficiency join them. How many more days will be required to complete the remaining work?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: 15 workers can complete a project in 24 days. They work for 8 days, after which 5 additional workers of the same efficiency join them. How many more days will be required to complete the remaining work?

Solution:
মোট কাজ = 15 × 24
= 360 শ্রমিক-দিন

প্রথম 8 দিনে 15 জন শ্রমিকের সম্পন্ন কাজ = 15 × 8
= 120 শ্রমিক-দিন

∴ অবশিষ্ট কাজ = 360 - 120
= 240 শ্রমিক-দিন

5 জন নতুন শ্রমিক যোগ দেওয়ার পর মোট শ্রমিক = 15 + 5
= 20 জন

∴ 20 জন শ্রমিকের অবশিষ্ট 240 শ্রমিক-দিন কাজ করতে সময় লাগবে = 240/20
= 12 দিন

∴ কাজটি সম্পন্ন করতে আরও 12 দিন লাগবে।
